T-001.root_cause: Webhook retry after a delivery timeout re-processed payment.succeeded without an idempotency key, charging the invoice twice.

T-002.root_cause: The API key is shared with a nightly batch sync job, which uses up the per-minute rate limit.

T-003.root_cause: The identity provider's SAML signing certificate expired on 2026-09-28 and metadata was never refreshed.

T-004.root_cause: The export query does a full table scan on orders for large accounts and exceeds the 30s gateway timeout.
